sentence: This project studies why multiciliated cells show natural DNA damage during development and how differentiated cells cope with DNA damage.
This project improves research software for medical image and shape analysis by adding machine learning support.
This project uses artificial intelligence to build tools that predict clinical outcomes of psychosis from electronic health records and genetic information.
This project studies how the bacteria that cause periodontitis kill mesenchymal stem cells and cause inflammation in gum disease.
This project studies how a gene controls vascular and neuronal function in Alzheimer’s disease and other neurodegenerative disorders.
This project provides mammalian cell culture services, including tissue culture techniques, cell line authentication and 3D organoid and spheroid cell culture.
This project provides histology and imaging services and equipment to cancer researchers.
This project studies how ultraviolet light causes rare DNA damage that becomes mutations in yeast and human genomes.
This project tests whether prosthetic grafts affect the left ventricle and distal aorta differently depending on the cause of genetically triggered aortic aneurysms.
This project studies how noise damages auditory nerve synapses and the neurons in the cochlear nucleus, leading to hearing loss.
This project studies how brain cell types and circuits respond to periodic visual or auditory stimulation that changes brain activity.
This project builds a computer tool that predicts the outcome of vertebral body tethering for each patient and each vertebral level.
This project uses statistical and machine learning methods to make imaging results for amyloid and tau from different tracers easier to compare.
This project provides data science tools, computing resources and bioinformatics consulting to support research that needs heavy computing.
This project studies the genes behind tooth development and inherited enamel defects, using mouse models.
This project studies the immune response against glioblastoma and how inhibitory molecules on myeloid immune cells affect immunity against the tumor.
This project studies what causes cysts to grow in polycystic kidney disease.
This project studies how delta opioid receptors change the transmission of parvalbumin interneurons in the prefrontal cortex after opioid dependence.
This project collects imaging data from patients with cardiac sarcoidosis to find measures that predict how well they respond to treatment.
